rules.deepseek-v4-flash/seed0: A row is RATIONAL if and only if the discriminant of the associated elliptic curve (or the corresponding modular equation) is a perfect square, which occurs exactly when the value of \(1/(6x_0)\) is an integer.
rules.deepseek-v4-flash/seed1: A row is RATIONAL if and only if the discriminant of the associated elliptic curve (or the corresponding modular equation) is a perfect square, which occurs exactly when the squarefree part of d is 1, 3, 5, 7, 13, or 17 (i.e., d is of the form n^2, 3n^2, 5n^2, 7n^2, 13n^2, or 17n^2 for integer n), while all other d yield irrational lambda.
rules.deepseek-v4-flash/seed2: A row is RATIONAL if and only if the discriminant of the associated elliptic curve (or the corresponding modular equation) is a perfect square, which occurs exactly when d is a squarefree integer congruent to 1, 3, 5, or 7 modulo 8 (i.e., d ≡ 1, 3, 5, 7 mod 8) and d is not divisible by any prime ≡ 3 mod 4 to an odd power, and in the given list this corresponds to d being a prime or product of distinct primes all ≡ 1 mod 4 (or d=1,3,5,7,13,17), while the NOT cases have d with at least one prime factor ≡ 3 mod 4 to an odd exponent or d ≡ 2 mod 4, etc.
rules.doubao-seed-2.1-lite/seed0: A row is RATIONAL if and only if d is a squarefree odd integer whose prime factors are all congruent to 1 modulo 4 (i.e., d ∈ {1, 5, 13, 17, 29, 37, ...}), and NOT otherwise.
rules.doubao-seed-2.1-lite/seed1: A parameter pair is RATIONAL if and only if its associated denominator value d is an odd divisor of 24 (i.e., d ∈ {1, 3, 5, 7, 13, 17}), and NOT otherwise.
rules.doubao-seed-2.1-lite/seed2: A parameter pair is RATIONAL if and only if its associated denominator value d is an odd prime divisor of 24 (i.e., d ∈ {1, 3, 5, 7, 13, 17}), and NOT otherwise.
rules.kimi-k2.8-preview/seed0: A row is RATIONAL exactly when \(1/x_0\) is an integer, and NOT otherwise.
rules.kimi-k2.8-preview/seed1: The row is RATIONAL exactly when \(d=1\) or \(d\) is an odd prime less than 18; all other \(d\) give NOT.
rules.kimi-k2.8-preview/seed2: A row is RATIONAL exactly when \(d+1\) is a prime number, and NOT otherwise.
